summary: Freeze the detached asyncio task retirement contract before changing the Python kernel: a task created by one cell must not mutate persistent globals or perform ordinary file side effects after that cell has returned and a later cell is executing.
steps: Re-read the current `_end_cell()` implementation and confirmed it retires only the bridge owner token plus pending query futures; arbitrary user asyncio Tasks are not tracked or cancelled.

Added two real-runtime regressions where cell 1 creates a delayed detached task, returns, and cell 2 waits past the delay; the expected contract keeps the terminal global value unchanged and prevents a late marker file.
Kept the RED test out of package.json on this temporary branch so it can run in parallel with the active #71/#83 runtime branch without manufacturing a package test-line conflict.

evidence.note: Confirmed no arbitrary asyncio task ownership registry or cancellation/drain barrier exists; the existing owner token only blocks late RLM bridge calls.
The tests-only branch will execute through its dedicated workflow before any production kernel change.

limitations: This is a RED-only branch and will be cleanly replayed from current main after #71/#83 merges before production changes are proposed.
Cancellation-resistant task policy and snapshot-consistency coverage will be added in the GREEN branch after the base race is reproduced.
